blind.B1: No. GSE273795 is liver RNA-seq of 12-month-old HFD-fed male C57BL/6J mice treated with R159 (gp130 Y814/SFK inhibitor) or vehicle for 12 weeks (S4.2, Fig 3e,f). No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor; voluntary wheel running (S2.4, S4.14) is a behavioural outcome only.
blind.B2: HFD-R159 vs HFD-Veh in liver, n = 3 per group (Fig 3 legend e,f). No other RNA-seq comparison.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one liver per mouse, 6 mice. Packet A's title-suffix key (rep1-3) is only a replicate label; the expression check says not_supported (r -0.036, p 0.68).
blind.B4: Paper does not say; two groups only, so joint vs pairwise is moot.
blind.B5: S4.6: 'Genes were considered to be differentially expressed based on fold change > 1.5 and p-value < 0.05' (DESeq2, median ratio normalization). No DEG total reported; Fig 3e shows enriched terms and Fig 3f a heat map of selected genes.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm in GEO metadata (no exercise words) or paper (S4.2, Fig 3); refusal matches B1.
No contrast run. Recorded groups HFD R159 3 / HFD Vehicle 3 match Fig 3 legend.
One liver per animal; title-suffix flag is a replicate label, expression check not_supported.
Not evaluated; case stopped. Paper gives no batch information.
Matrix is median-ratio-normalized EM estimates (3.8% integers, max 4.79e6); recorded as estimated counts with the discrepancy noted. The skill has no 'normalized counts' type word.
paper_threshold: raw p < 0.05, |FC| > 1.5 -> log2 0.585, exclusive; matches S4.6 verbatim.
No counts compared; HANDBACK correctly says the paper gives no DEG total.
'No exercise contrast: all 6 samples HFD, R159 vs vehicle' is true; checked against metadata levels and paper methods. Wheel running is not a group factor.

summary: 该系列是 R159 药物对比溶媒的肝脏 RNA-seq(每组3只),不含运动组,拒绝分析的理由成立。阈值转录与论文一致,无配对重复测量。仅有一个次要备注:矩阵为已归一化的估计计数,技能中没有对应类型词。
